sub_study_name: Symmetric sessions with two public draws after the fourth prediction
instructions: Urn A contains two light balls and one dark ball, while urn B contains one light ball and two dark balls. The urns have equal prior probability. Positions 1-4 decide from their private draw and earlier public predictions. After the fourth prediction, two additional draws are made with replacement and publicly revealed. Positions 5 and 6 observe both public draws, their own private draw, and all earlier predictions before deciding.

items.question: Which urn do you predict was selected?
